Name: Cooked Dish Price and Quality
Author: mithril1257
Description:
[heading]功能[/heading]
1. 按材料计算菜肴基础售价（范围内可自由调整）
2. 菜肴星级（可开关）
3. 是否溯源烹饪材料
在 GMCM 中新增选项 [b]“是否溯源烹饪材料”[/b]，默认开启。
开启后会同时启用两项行为：
[list=1]
[*][b]鼠标悬停显示材料来源[/b][/*]
[*][b]不同材料做出的菜肴不再堆叠[/b][/*]
[/list]4. 兼容性设计
[list]
[*][b]SVE（Stardew Valley Expanded）[/b][/*]
[*][b]Love of Cooking 2.x[/b]：针对其 
[list]
[*]调味料属于可选添加物，[b]不计入[/b]材料公式；只有配方实际要求的材料计入。[/*]
[*]批量烹饪时，材料总价值按实际产出的菜肴数量均摊。[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]其他增加食谱的 Content Patcher / JSON Assets / SpaceCore 配方[/b]：只要最终通过原版或 Love of Cooking 的烹饪流程产出菜肴，就会生效[/*]
[*]Yet Another Cooking Skill 2
[list]
[*]菜肴价格仍按本模组的材料公式计算。[/*]
[*]当本模组的“烹饪菜肴带有星级”开启时，[b]星级交给 YACS2 自己计算[/b]，本模组的“最低/最高”不会强行覆盖它，避免破坏 YACS2 的烹饪技能、食材品质和职业机制。[/*]
[*]当本模组的星级关闭时，仍会强制成品为无星。[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Better Crafting
[list]
[*]支持从附近箱子取材料烹饪，并正确按实际消耗材料定价。[/*]
[*]溯源模式下会处理手中已有的菜肴，避免因为“不同来源不可堆叠”导致 Better Crafting 无法继续烹饪。[/*]
[*]对不同材料的菜肴保留独立的材料记录和价格。[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]5. 其他细节
[list]
[*]只影响[b]新烹饪[/b]的菜肴；已经存在存档里的旧菜肴不会追溯改价。[/*]
[*]配方一次产出多份时，材料价值会平均分摊到每份菜肴。[/*]
[*]未开启材料溯源时，同品质菜肴合并到同一堆，价格按两批菜肴的总价值做[b]加权平均[/b]，不会让旧菜的价值被新菜直接覆盖。[/*]
[*]开启材料溯源时，不同材料来源的菜肴不会合并；相同来源的菜肴合并后价格本来就相同，不会产生冲突。[/*]
[*]材料价值不含职业加成；这样同一配方在不同职业下保持稳定，也避免“职业加成 → 菜肴价格 → 再作为材料”的循环放大。[/*]
[*]兼容多人游戏：价格由烹饪的玩家本地计算，物品价格会随物品同步。[/*]
[/list][heading]安装[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]安装 [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] 和 [b]星露谷物语 1.6+[/b]。[/*]
[*]（推荐）安装 [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]，以便在游戏内配置。[/*]
[/list]
Function
1. Calculate base dish price based on ingredients (adjustable within a range) 
2. Dish star rating (toggleable) 
3. Track ingredient sourcing 
A new option "Track Ingredient Sourcing" has been added to GMCM, enabled by default. 
When enabled, two behaviors are activated: 
- Hovering over an item displays its source 
- Dishes made from different ingredients no longer stack 

4. Compatibility Design 
SVE (Stardew Valley Expanded) 
Love of Cooking 2.x: For this mod, 
- Seasonings are considered optional additives and are not included in the ingredient formula; only ingredients explicitly required by the recipe are counted. 
- When cooking in bulk, the total ingredient value is evenly distributed across the number of dishes actually produced. 
Other recipe additions via Content Patcher / JSON Assets / SpaceCore: As long as the dish is ultimately created through the original game's or Love of Cooking's cooking process, it will be supported.
Yet Another Cooking Skill 2
Dish prices are still calculated according to this mod's material formula. 
When the "Cooking Dishes with Stars" option in this mod is enabled, star ratings are calculated independently by YACS2; this mod's "minimum/maximum" settings will not override them, preventing interference with YACS2's cooking skill, ingredient quality, and profession mechanics. 
When the star rating feature in this mod is disabled, the final dish will still be forced to have no stars.
Better Crafting
Supports retrieving ingredients from nearby crates for cooking and accurately pricing dishes based on actual material consumption. 
In traceability mode, existing dishes in hand will be processed to prevent Better Crafting from being blocked due to the "non-stacking of different sources" rule. 
Maintains separate ingredient records and pricing for dishes made with different materials. 

5. Other Details 
Only affects newly cooked dishes; pre-existing dishes saved in archives will not have their prices retroactively adjusted. 
When a recipe produces multiple servings at once, the ingredient value is evenly distributed across each dish. 
When material tracing is disabled, dishes of the same quality are merged into a single stack, with prices calculated as a weighted average based on the total value of both batches—ensuring old dishes' values aren't directly overwritten by new ones. 
When material tracing is enabled, dishes from different ingredient sources won't merge; dishes from the same source, when merged, already share identical prices, avoiding conflicts. 
Ingredient values do not include class bonuses, ensuring consistent pricing for the same recipe across different classes and preventing cyclical amplification where "class bonus → dish price → used as ingredient" could escalate. 
Compatible with multiplayer: prices are locally calculated by the player who cooks, and item prices sync accordingly across players.
Installation
Install SMAPI 4.0+ and Stardew Valley 1.6+. 
(Recommended) Install Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game configuration.
